# [570. 至少有5名直接下属的经理](https://leetcode-cn.com/problems/managers-with-at-least-5-direct-reports) [English Version](https://github.com/yanglr/leetcode-ac/blob/master/assets/0500-0599/0570.Managers%20with%20at%20Least%205%20Direct%20Reports/README_EN.md) ## 题目描述

Employee 表包含所有员工和他们的经理。每个员工都有一个 Id，并且还有一列是经理的 Id。

+------+----------+-----------+----------+
|Id    |Name 	  |Department |ManagerId |
+------+----------+-----------+----------+
|101   |John 	  |A 	      |null      |
|102   |Dan 	  |A 	      |101       |
|103   |James 	  |A 	      |101       |
|104   |Amy 	  |A 	      |101       |
|105   |Anne 	  |A 	      |101       |
|106   |Ron 	  |B 	      |101       |
+------+----------+-----------+----------+

给定 Employee 表，请编写一个SQL查询来查找至少有5名直接下属的经理。对于上表，您的SQL查询应该返回：

+-------+
| Name  |
+-------+
| John  |
+-------+

注意:
没有人是自己的下属。
